description.value: Luppolo Brewing is a Vancouver craft brewery and tasting room inspired by the convivial atmosphere of the Italian birrificio, operating for nearly a decade at 1123 Venables St. in the Grandview-Woodland neighbourhood. The brewery produces a wide and rotating range of craft beers — from pilsners and lagers to sours, stouts, and IPAs — and partners with Local Pizzaiolo for hand-stretched authentic Italian pizzas made fresh daily. A seasonal dog-friendly patio and fully wheelchair-accessible space make it a welcoming stop for cyclists exploring Vancouver's east side.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 65m. Total: 3 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and provides strong evidence for this listing. The FAQ page confirms wheelchair-accessible washrooms exist, the beer menu lists a 'Cans to go' section confirming takeout, and the food menu explicitly labels vegan (VEGAN), vegetarian (v), and gluten-free (gf/gf option) items with the FAQ further confirming GF drink options. No mention of bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging appears anywhere on the site.
